source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 80 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-80.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 80 was established by Ordinance No. 14912, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 16, 1975. Ordinance No. 14912 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the 1960 Revised Code of Civil and Criminal Ordinances of the City of Dallas. Ordinance No. 14912 was amended by Resolution No. 75-3650, passed by the Dallas City Council on December 15, 1975. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 14912; 25423; Res. 75-3650)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-80.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 80 is established on property generally located at the southwest corner of Millett Drive and R.L. Thorton Freeway. The size of PD 80 is approximately 21.30 acres. (Ord. Nos. 14912; 25423)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-80.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS. article.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25423)

sections.title: Conceptual Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-80.104.CONCEPTUAL PLAN. A conceptual plan (Exhibit 80A) indicating use districts by tracts, as approved by the city plan commission, is attached to and a part of Ordinance No. 14912. (Ord. Nos. 14912; 25423)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-80.105.DEVELOPMENT PLAN. The Phase I development plan (Exhibit 80B), as approved by the city plan commission, is attached to and a part of Ordinance No. 14912. A development plan for each additional phase as referenced on the conceptual plan must be approved by the city plan commission, attested by the chairman of the city plan commission and the director of development services prior to the issuance of any building permits within the designated phase, and attached to and made a part of Ordinance No. 14912 by resolution of the city council. (Ord. Nos. 14912; 25423; Res. 75-3650)

sections.title: Compliance With Plans
sections.text: SEC. 51P-80.106.COMPLIANCE WITH PLANS. Development within the PD must be in accordance with the conceptual and development plans. (Ord. Nos. 14912; 25423)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-80.107.USES. The uses permitted in this PD are as follows:
(1)Uses within Tract I are limited to an institution of a religious and charitable nature, including a residence home for the aged, a nursing home, and a church.
(2)Uses within Tract II are limited to an institution of a religious and charitable nature, including low-rise housing for the aged.
(3)Uses within Tract III are limited to a gift shop and a restaurant in accordance with those uses permitted in a NS Neighborhood Service District. (Ord. Nos. 14912; 25423)

sections.title: Maximum Height
sections.text: SEC. 51P-80.108.MAXIMUM HEIGHT. Building heights in this PD are limited to those heights as designated on the conceptual plan. (Ord. Nos. 14912; 25423)

sections.title: Fire Department Requirements
sections.text: SEC. 51P-80.109.FIRE DEPARTMENT REQUIREMENTS. All buildings must be constructed with a 100 percent automatic sprinkler system. Fire lanes must be provided in accordance with the requirements of the fire department. (Ord. Nos. 14912; 25423)

sections.title: Drainage And Utility Requirements
sections.text: SEC. 51P-80.110.DRAINAGE AND UTILITY REQUIREMENTS. Drainage and utility requirements must comply with the requirements of the department of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 14912; 25423)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text: SEC. 51P-80.111.LANDSCAPING. Minimum landscaping must be provided as shown on the development plans. Additional landscaping may be provided as the developer desires. (Ord. Nos. 14912; 25423)

sections.title: Lighting
sections.text: SEC. 51P-80.112.LIGHTING. Light poles or standards located in parking areas may not exceed eight feet in height and must be covered to deflect light downward. (Ord. Nos. 14912; 25423)

sections.title: Ingress And Egress
sections.text: SEC. 51P-80.113.INGRESS AND EGRESS. All ingress an egress must comply with the requirements of the department of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 14912; 25423)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text: SEC. 51P-80.114.SIGNS. All signs on every tract must comply with Article IV, “Non-business Districts,” of Chapter 41A, “Sign Standards,” of the Dallas City Code, except that a maximum of two detached premise signs are permitted on Tract I, one detached premise sign is permitted on Tract II, and one detached premise sign is permitted on Tract III. (Ord. Nos. 14912; 25423)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text: SEC. 51P-80.115.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS. Development within this PD must be in compliance with all other requirements of the city. (Ord. Nos. 14912; 25423)

sections.title: Streets And Paving
sections.text: SEC. 51P-80.116.STREETS AND PAVING. All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 14912; 25423; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text: SEC. 51P-80.117.COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS. No certificate of occupancy may be issued by the building official until there has been full compliance with this article and any applicable provisions of the zoning ordinance and the building codes. (Ord. Nos. 14912; 25423)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-80.118.ZONING MAP. PD 80 is located on Zoning Map Nos. O-6 and O-7. (Ord. 25423)
